name: 12b_dspark
description: 12B Gemma4 dense DSpark config: FP8 target (identical env/sampling/concurrency to 12b_e011_mtp baseline) + DSpark draft (deepseek-ai/dspark_gemma4_12b_block7). spec_method=dspark uses vLLM --speculative-config (method=dspark). Native block size = 7, so spec_tokens=7 (vs 5 for MTP/eagle3). gpu_memory_utilization lowered to 0.8 for the 262144-vocab draft headroom (per vLLM PR #47216). Apples-to-apples vs 12b_e011_mtp except draft+method+spec_tokens.
